items.title: India introduces windfall tax on petrol and diesel exports
items.text: A government order reported on 15 October set an export duty of ₹2.50 per litre on petrol and ₹8.50 per litre on diesel, effective 16 October 2026.

items.title: IMF projects India could become the world's fourth-largest economy in 2027
items.text: The IMF's October 2026 outlook is reported to project India's nominal GDP at about US$4.52 trillion in 2027, potentially moving it ahead of Japan. GDP rankings depend on nominal dollar values and exchange rates.

items.title: Indian Navy schedules commissioning of multi-purpose vessel Samarthak at Karwar
items.text: Samarthak, built by Larsen & Toubro under the Make in India initiative, is scheduled to be commissioned at Naval Base Karwar on 16 October. It is the first of four planned multi-purpose vessels and can support patrol, trials, unmanned systems and disaster-relief missions.
items.source: Prompt Innovations, summarising Ministry of Defence information, 2026-10-13

items.title: World Food Day 2026 highlights innovation in food systems
items.text: World Food Day is observed on 16 October. The 2026 theme is “Innovate today. Nourish tomorrow.”, highlighting innovation and inclusive approaches to build sustainable, resilient agrifood systems.
items.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, 2026-10-16

items.title: West Indies level the T20I series after defeating India in Hyderabad
items.text: West Indies won the fourth T20 International on 14 October by 24 runs, scoring 247/3 before bowling India out for 223. The result levelled the five-match series at 2–2.

items.title: Fairfax's proposed majority acquisition of IDBI Bank receives government approval
items.text: Reporting on the CCEA approval says Fairfax Financial Holdings may acquire a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank. The report notes regulatory conditions involving Fairfax's existing Catholic Syrian Bank holding.

quiz.q: What export duty on petrol was reported to take effect in India on 16 October 2026?
quiz.a: ₹2.50 per litre. The reported diesel export duty was ₹8.50 per litre.
